rows.grounds: Compound of sahasra (thousand), nāma (name), and pāṭha (recitation), with enclitic ca (and) indicating conjunction with the following item.
Compound of kālī (Kālī), nāma (name), and prakīrtana (proclamation/recitation), denoting the act of proclaiming Kālī's names.

items.question: Which verbal recitations are prescribed alongside the śivābali offering in the empty circle?
premises: The recitation of the thousand names is prescribed.
The proclamation of Kālī's names is prescribed.
Both acts are conjoined as part of the same ritual context.
items.inference: The ritual requires both the thousand-name recitation and the proclamation of Kālī's names.
uncertainties: The specific thousand-name text intended is not identified within this verse.
items.plain_english: And the recitation of the thousand names, together with the proclamation of the names of Kālī.
